description: Render JSON data into a polished PDF (or a PNG preview of one page) and save it to disk. `template` is optional: omit it to auto-detect or use the generic layout. Returns the saved file path, the template used, and page count.

data.description: The document content as a JSON object.

format.description: pdf (default) or png (one page, returned as an image too).

output_path.description: Where to save the file. Default: <template>-<timestamp>.pdf in the working directory.

page.description: Page to render when format is png (default 1).

template.description: Template name from list_templates. Omit to auto-detect.

test.description: Free watermarked test render, not counted against the quota. Use while iterating on the data; omit for the final document.

name: render_document
title: Render a PDF document
